title: MLIR-MRacle: Memory-Model-Aware Metamorphic Fuzzing of Concurrent MLIR
abstract: arXiv:2611.24804v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-level compilers built on MLIR lower concurrent programs through many stages towards targets with potentially drastically different memory models, where an optimisation which appears reasonable, can silently change program behaviour. Testing these lowerings is hard: a concurrent program often has no single expected outcome, and existing MLIR fuzzers often assume determinism. We present MLIR-MRacle, a memory-model-aware metamorphic fuzzer for concurrent MLIR programs. MLIR-MRacle applies metamorphic relations gated by the target memory model, so that both the original and transformed programs remain well defined - executing both repeatedly, and comparing their outcome sets or distributions withone of two statistical oracles. A coverage guided campaign driver built on libafl is used to perform continuous fuzzing. MRs, memory models, oracles, and execution backends all provide extension points for future researchers and compiler engine

translated_title: MLIR-MRacle：内存模型感知的并发MLIR蜕变模糊测试
translated_abstract: 基于MLIR构建的多层次编译器将并发程序经过多个阶段降低至目标平台，而这些目标平台的内存模型可能截然不同，在这种情况下，一个看似合理的优化可能会悄然改变程序行为。测试这些降低过程非常困难：并发程序通常没有单一的预期结果，而现有的MLIR模糊测试工具往往假设程序具有确定性。我们提出了MLIR-MRacle，这是一个面向并发MLIR程序的内存模型感知的蜕变模糊测试工具。MLIR-MRacle应用由目标内存模型调控的蜕变关系，使得原始程序和转换后的程序都保持良定义——重复执行两者，并通过两个统计预言机之一来比较它们的结果集合或分布。该工具采用基于libafl构建的覆盖率引导的测试活动驱动器来执行持续模糊测试。蜕变关系、内存模型、预言机和执行后端均提供了扩展点，供未来的研究者和编译器工程师使用。
tldr: MLIR-MRacle是一个内存模型感知的蜕变模糊测试工具，通过目标内存模型调控的蜕变关系与统计预言机来检测并发MLIR编译过程中可能悄然改变程序行为的优化错误。
en_tdlr: MLIR-MRacle is a memory-model-aware metamorphic fuzzer that detects optimizations silently altering concurrent program behavior during MLIR lowering, using metamorphic relations gated by target memory models and statistical oracles.
